latestVerifiedPriorRelease.evidenceScope: Externally verified prior production release. This receipt is committed only after canonical, origin, and public GitHub main matched content SHA b360212653852b6964a3a43060a7930229016617; Vercel deployment dpl_jp96refFJurzz964qhHfyq2rm1Sj was READY and carried that exact commit metadata; isitusa.com resolved to it; GitHub Production deployment 5952766003 and commit context Vercel were successful; immutable desktop and canonical mobile browser flows passed with no successful-flow console errors, warnings, broken images, or horizontal overflow; ZIP 21502 resolved to Allegany County; Small Carpgrass rendered; a nonexistent species returned 404; four live generated files matched committed bytes and SHA-256; and exact-deployment runtime error and warning queries returned zero rows. Round 69 closed all known repository-side GBIF acquisition, replay, partition, transaction-recovery, bounded-integrity, and offline end-to-end publication blockers. It also replaced 2,504-species static pre-generation with verified on-demand caching to clear the provider compile ceiling. The selected GBIF scope remains 13 taxa and 25,406 true not-researched county-species pairs, but GBIF_USERNAME, GBIF_PASSWORD, and GBIF_EMAIL were absent from all inspected approved stores. Therefore zero provider calls, zero archives, and zero research movement are truthfully recorded. This receipt does not attest to the commit that contains it or any future deployment.
